Description: Infection through contact with infectious individuals in the community, in hospital, or during funerals.
Progression from latent infection to symptomatic infectiousness.
Hospitalization of infectious community cases.
Death of infectious community cases before hospitalization.
Death of hospitalized cases.

Name: a
Description: Inverse of the mean incubation period.

Name: c_h
Description: Inverse of the mean duration from symptom onset to hospitalization.

Name: c_d
Description: Inverse of the mean duration from symptom onset to death.

Name: c_i
Description: Inverse of the mean duration from symptom onset to end of infectiousness for survivors.

Name: c_f
Description: Inverse of the mean duration from death to traditional burial.

Name: h
Description: Proportion of infectious cases hospitalized.

Name: d
Description: Case-fatality ratio.

Name: b_I
Description: Transmission rate in the community.

Name: b_H
Description: Transmission rate in hospital.

Name: b_F
Description: Transmission rate during traditional burial.

Name: N
Description: Population size.

Name: z
Description: Efficacy of interventions in reducing community transmission.
Value: 12% decrease in community transmission after interventions (DRC 1995); 88% decrease in community transmission after interventions (Uganda 2000)

Name: h_1
Description: Probability parameter used so that h% of infectious cases are hospitalized.
Value: Computed from h, c_i, c_d, c_h, and d to match the hospitalization proportion

Name: d_1
Description: Probability parameter used so that the overall case-fatality ratio equals d.
Value: Computed from d, c_i, c_d, and c_h

Name: d_2
Description: Probability parameter used so that the overall case-fatality ratio equals d.
Value: Computed from d, c_i, c_d, and c_h

Name: R_0
Description: Basic reproduction number.
